description: Roadway Sections North 2018 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration. State DOTs provide the location limits of highway sections to be used to represent statewide aggregations based on a statistically valid Sample Panel. The North contains data for the following States: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, New York, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Maryland, District of Columbia, and Delaware. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 10 columns, among them State_Code, Route_ID, Begin_Point, End_Point, Data_Item, Value_Numeric. The portal shows 2021-01-05 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
